visibility_levels.meaning: Safe for the public student agenda and public course repository.
Safe for the co-teacher and this private repository, including assessment links, teacher guides, and answer keys.
Personal/local tools and data that must never be copied into the shared teacher repository.

teacher_view_rules: Read-only: no Planner controls and no links into local Teacher Tools.
Show the same selected current week and All Weeks history as the student agenda.
Show the exact student-facing resources actually used on each day.
Add teacher-only rows for teacher guides, assessment files, answer keys, and other teacher-shared artifacts.
Quick Check and Summative Assessment may be display-only for students while their secure links appear in teacher-only rows.
Never include student names, grades, evidence reports, or other student data.
